title: Refactor diary recording storage to native binary sublevels
body: ### Motivation - Eliminate runtime base64 encode/decode cycles for binary audio data stored in LevelDB and store binary content natively instead. - Reduce JS-side CPU and memory overhead when handling PCM/WAV fragments by using LevelDB sublevels with `buffer` encoding. - Centralize binary-sublevel traversal so higher-level code can use typed binary get/put/batch operations without ad-hoc JSON wrappers. - Preserve upgrade/restart continuity for data already persisted in the legacy JSON/base64 layout by adding compatibility read+migrate paths. ### Description - Add native binary sublevel support to the temporary DB surface by exposing `getBinarySublevel` and a `TemporaryBinarySublevel` facade for buffer-encoded operations, and extract facade helpers into `backend/src/temporary/binary_sublevel_facades.js`. - Migrate generic temporary blob APIs to use a dedicated `binary` sublevel so `storeBlob`, `getBlob`, `deleteBlob`, `markDone`, `isDone`, and `storeBlobsAndMarkDone` operate on `Buffer` values directly (no JSON `blob` entries or base64 strings). - Rework audio session storage so PCM chunks and cached final WAV are persisted under `audio_session/sessions//binary/...` as raw `Buffer` values and remove all `toString('base64')` / `Buffer.from(..., 'base64')` conversions. - Update live-diary session state to persist the `last_fragment` as a native buffer in a `binary` sublevel instead of a base64-encoded JSON blob. - Add one-time compatibility read+migrate behavior for legacy entries: - `temporary.getBlob` and `temporary.isDone` now fall back to legacy root JSON entries, migrate to the `binary` sublevel, and delete legacy keys. - `audio_recording_session.fetchFinalAudio` now falls back to legacy cached `final` JSON entry and legacy `chunk` JSON sublevel entries, migrates them into binary storage, and cleans up legacy keys. - `live_diary/session_state.readLastFragment` now falls back to legacy JSON/base64 `last_fragment`, migrates to binary storage, and cleans up legacy key. - Introduce a dedicated `TemporarySublevelPathError` (with type guard) for empty-path facade failures instead of generic `Error`. - Correct the audio-session key-layout documentation comment to match the actual on-disk layout (`audio_session/sessions//meta`). - Keep `blob` in temporary DB JSON union typing strictly for legacy compatibility reads during migration. ### Testing - Ran environment setup with `npm install` which completed successfully. - Ran focused Jest suites with `npx jest backend/tests/audio_recording_session.test.js backend/tests/live_diary.test.js backend/tests/upload.test.js` and all targeted suites passed. - Added/updated regression tests for legacy compatibility migration paths in: - `backend/tests/audio_recording_session.test.js` - `backend/tests/live_diary.test.js` - `backend/tests/upload.test.js` - Ran static analysis with `npm run static-analysis` (typecheck + eslint) and it passed. - Verified frontend build with `npm run build` and it succeeded. - Ran full test suite with `npm test`; all test suites passed. ------ Codex Task
